hypothesis: Matching negative examples on prompt ID may reduce topic shortcuts in author attribution.
evidence_status: Untested task-specific extension; SupCon establishes class-positive contrastive learning, not this prompt-control benefit.
method_review: Original SupCon averages positive log probabilities outside the log, excludes self comparisons, and operates on normalized projections. V18 loss retains that form with temperature/base-temperature ratio one. Original paper studies images; crossed text prompt sampling plus joint CE is our extension.
comparison: Both arms restore identical V18 4500-row external-only adapter, norm, head and projection. Same Qwen3-4B, tokenizer, host data, seed, two epochs, batch4, accumulation8, CE plus 0.1 SupCon, learning rates and fixed final V19 readout. Only host batch sampling changes.
control: Existing V18 independent prompt draws for each of two authors.
candidate: Two authors and two shared host prompt IDs form all four cells. Same-author positives span prompts; each anchor has a same-prompt different-author negative.
external_groups: Existing preparation constructs external groups from source + prompt_key. Cross-source prompt equivalence is not established. No external prompt matching or new external training is performed.

scoring.metric: Mean class recall, raw fixed V19 readout
scoring.readout: Layers 12/24/36, standardized logistic C=.02, mean log probabilities
scoring.secondary: Ordinary accuracy and existing fixed sparse blend may be reported, never used to replace primary gate.

screen_gate.next_step: Broader folds and full-incumbent ensemble evaluation; never automatic submission.

runtime.evidence: Recorded V18 host stage about1483s plus V19 readout264s per fold. Two folds sequentially per arm, arms parallel on two T4 GPUs; estimate includes modest overhead but is not guaranteed.
runtime.execution: One independent arm per GPU; terminate process groups at global deadline.
runtime.launch_requires: Parent coordination, current quota and offline dependency preflight

portable.execution: Single GPU, independent then crossed; both fixed folds in each arm
portable.setup_estimate_status: Planning allowance, not measured; depends on image and download throughput
portable.billing_guard: Parent preflight must include setup, runtime and storage, and terminate paid pod after archive. Internal process timeout alone does not stop billing.

limitations: All host labels previously inspected; this is a screening comparison, not untouched confirmation.
Sampling with replacement changes row exposure and negative difficulty; seed alone does not equate individual examples across arms.
Single missing author/prompt cell handled by pairwise shared-prompt intersection, with slight sampling distribution change.
No claim of improvement over .622 without full inference submission.
Inference needs one text only, no prompt ID or other authors; same adapter architecture and cost as incumbent component.
attribution: SupCon: Khosla et al.; Qwen model: Qwen team; public external pool: Nishant Dahal and original contributors. This experiment changes sampling only.
